\caption{Few-shot unconstrained baseline as a function of the number of valid training samples $N$. For each constraint, $N$ points satisfying $P(x) \le 0$ are rejection-sampled and the unconditional flow matcher that ECI and HardFlow sample from is fine-tuned on them with learning rate $10^{-4}$, restarting from the same base weights each time, so every row is one fine-tuned model per constraint of the 1000-polynomial validation set. Values are medians. Training length is chosen by early stopping against 10{,}000 held-out constraint-satisfying points, far more data than the model is allowed to train on; this removes training length as a confound but makes these numbers an optimistic upper bound on the baseline. The base model itself is kept whenever no fine-tuning step improves on it.}
